content: Error Name: ETHSWT_E_ACCESS Short Description: Ethernet Switch Access Failure Long Description: This production error shall be issued when the switch is not accessible. Recommended DTC: N/A Fail When access to the Ethernet Switch fails the module shall report the extended production error with event status DEM_EVENT_STATUS_ PREFAILED to DEM. Detection Criteria: Pass When access to the Ethernet Switch succeeds the module shall report the extended production error with event status DEM_EVENT_STATUS_ PREPASSED to DEM.
